headline: Sketch to a colored SVG icon
job: Turn your own rough drawing into a fully colored, editable SVG icon.
purpose: Start with a Sketch image input. Qwen Image 2.1 Edit makes the separate Color render while preserving the drawing composition, then Ideogram Vector converts that colored raster into SVG shapes. Converting the pencil sketch directly only traces the pencil marks.
edit: Replace Sketch image with your drawing. Keep or edit Color render instruction to choose the palette and style. Keep the Vector prompt blank and its operation set to convert; its image wire must come from Color render · Qwen Image 2.1 Edit.
inspect: Compare all three stages: the original sketch, the Color render and the returned SVG. Check that the composition survives, the icon regions have colored fills, and the SVG agrees with the color render. Zoom in and open it in a vector editor; an embedded raster is not a vector result.
